about: Nostr relay frames, events and the NIPs' display forms, as other programs and the NIP texts give them. coax/lib/nostr/ is the only folder that parses them: message.coax reads a relay frame into NostrMessage, nip42.coax reads the AUTH challenge, event.coax reads and verifies an event into NostrEvent, nip19-core.coax reads a NIP-19 string into N19_Result, nip06.coax derives the NIP-06 key. Each fixture names where its bytes came from and the values our records must hold. Checked by coax/lib/nostr/nips-external-profile.coax.
